description: Browse recent community threads (no keywords; to find posts by keyword use search_questions; for catalog tools use search_tools). Example: {"category":"mcp","limit":5}. Sorted by latest activity unless sort=new; limit 1–20, default 10.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous list_questions response; omit for the first page.

limit.description: Number of threads to return, integer 1–20, default 10.

tool.description: Catalog slug of a related tool

name: list_questions
